design: One treated no-history navigation use on known paper, no comparator, no pre-supplied coordinates/images or numerical answers.
acceptance: Locate requested figure and complete caption on raw page, retain row/column labels, units and legend.
Keep locator annotations separate from unannotated evidence.
Use frozen tools; record actual rectangles/source hashes and preserve failures.
Inspect first crop and document whether recropping was necessary, without general efficacy inference.
stopping: Once only, no selective rerun or author core repair; interrupt local call >120s or total >900s.
